summary:
This law cancels a rule made by the Bureau of Land Management. The Bureau of Land Management is a government office that takes care of public lands. The rule was about a plan for the Miles City Field Office. 

The rule was made on November 20, 2024. It was a plan for how to manage the land and resources there. Congress did not agree with this rule. By passing this law, Congress is saying the rule is canceled. The rule will have no power or effect.

The President approved this law on December 11, 2025. Now, the plan from the Bureau of Land Management will not be used.
